name: equals
description: Checks if two values are equal.
_note: There are some corner cases where this primitive can be incorrect. For example, when adding two floats and checking equality (ex 0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3) causes floating point issues. Poorly implemented _eq_ methods can also cause issues. However, in this case, since I am synthesizing the implementation, I use the participants directly in the equality and this since I also synthesize the participants, I can account for the _eq_ methods. I am leaving this note here so I am aware of these issues with the realization of this meaning.
